mapper.select: SELECT o.*, u.UserName, p.PetName, s.StoreName, pr.PrescriptionNo FROM pet_order o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.UserID = u.UserID LEFT JOIN pet p ON o.PetID = p.PetID LEFT JOIN store s ON o.StoreID = s.StoreID LEFT JOIN petmedicalprescription pr ON o.prescription_id = pr.PrescriptionID WHERE o.UserID = #{userId} ORDER BY o.OrderID ASC
